name: Artificial Neural Network / Perceptron (neuralnet)
when_to_use: Continuous (regression) or categorical (classification) dependent variable; standardized numeric predictors (0-1); compared in the material against Random Forest.

expected_input.question: How to model nonlinear relationships with a simple neural network?

plain_explanation.purpose: Minimal neural network, a single neuron, that learns to separate two classes with a line.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: To learn the basic concept of a neural network or separate simple cases.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Numeric factor columns and a response with two classes.
plain_explanation.example: Classify messages as urgent or not, from two measures.
plain_explanation.diagram: inputs x weights -> sum -> exceeds threshold? -> yes/no
